newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Monterey Resources.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Monterey Resources.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said it initiated coverage of Monterey Resources Inc with a market outperformer rating.
-- Goldman analyst Don Textor declined to provide additional details.

-- Monterey launched its initial public offering on November 14. Its parent, Santa Fe Energy Resources, sold about 15 percent of the company in public markets. Santa Fe still owns 85 percent of Monterey.
-- Goldman was the lead underwriter of the offering.
-- Monterey Resources was down 1/8 to 15-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
